reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: The function-local static lbool owns whether an unknown-length log drain was attempted; tried starts false and persists across calls.
limitations: tried owns a process-wide drain-attempt flag, not the log stream.

aliases_escapes.analysis: The tried bit retains no pointer, but end_logfile dereferences thisfile while interpreting it and drains the current log/input owner.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Attempt state cannot keep the current filestate live.
limitations: A later stream can observe a flag left by an earlier drain.

callback_targets.analysis: tried gates direct ierror/ch_forw_get calls during drain; those calls may enter display/input owners while the guard is set.
callback_targets.invariant: Drain callbacks still require stable external owners.
limitations: The direct drain loop runs after setting tried and has no per-stream callback token.

invalidation.analysis: Once true the guard is not reset for another log stream, so tried does not carry identity for the specific FD, filename or ifile it first guarded.
invalidation.invariant: A process guard is not a stream-generation identity.
limitations: tried is process-scoped and has no log-generation identity; a later or reentrant stream can observe a prior drain attempt.

mutation_commit.analysis: It is set before draining; log close and filename retirement occur later and are not committed atomically with this tried flag.

release_pair.analysis: end_logfile closes a still-open log FD once, sets -1 and frees/nulls namelogfile; the tried Boolean itself is static and never freed.
release_pair.invariant: One-shot state does not own the log descriptor.
limitations: The guard value cannot close the descriptor used by the drain.

error_cleanup.analysis: tried records an attempted drain rather than successful writes; sticky LOG_FAILED separately records hard write/close failure.
error_cleanup.invariant: An attempted drain is not a successful log-write receipt.

signals_handoff.analysis: tried does not retain an active filestate or log identity across cleanup reentry; polling signals is not an owner-exclusion protocol.
signals_handoff.invariant: M0-MEM-001 remains recorded for drain reentry.
limitations: M0-IO-004 remains open; this guard review does not label the improved short-write handling as an unresolved observed failure.
